description: SMPTE timecode conversion: drop-frame and non-drop, frames, exact seconds — Converts up to 200 timecodes, frame counts or times between SMPTE HH:MM:SS:FF (non-drop), HH:MM:SS;FF (drop-frame, 29.97 and 59.94), frame numbers and exact rational seconds, for an agent editing video, captions or logs at a stated frame rate. Rates are integers, a rational like 30000/1001, or the named 23.976, 29.97, 59.94, 119.88; any other decimal is rejected, never rounded. Integer arithmetic

timecode.description: HH:MM:SS:FF, or HH:MM:SS;FF / HH:MM:SS.FF for drop-frame.

name: timecode-convert
